content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fort Wayne

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Review PMI's education and professional experience requirements for the PMP credential. Most candidates need either a four-year degree with project-management experience or equivalent work history. Granite PM Academy's team can help you verify your qualifications before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Boot Camp, delivered by experienced instructors. This formal, structured education covers the PMBOK® Guide framework and exam domains. Complete the full curriculum to earn the 35 required contact hours and prepare strategically for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Create your PMI account and submit your official application with your verified education and experience details. Pay the exam fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy staff will guide you through the submission process and answer procedural questions.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and instructor support to strengthen weak areas. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner. Test your knowledge under realistic conditions and submit your answers to earn your PMP credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) every three years to renew your PMP. Granite PM Academy offers continuing education and PDU-eligible courses to help you stay current with project-management practices and meet PMI's renewal cycle.
